item.title: How to send emails with SendGrid in Node.js
item.description: Using a dedicated email service like SendGrid provides better deliverability, analytics, and scalability compared to traditional SMTP servers. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve integrated SendGrid into enterprise Node.js applications. The most efficient approach is using the official @sendgrid/mail package with an API key for authentication. This method offers reliable email delivery with built-in retry logic and detailed sending statistics.
